instruction: Set the editor tab size to 2 and enable format on save in VS Code settings.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened VS Code settings, navigated to Auto Save dropdown, selected afterDelay, then searched for auto save delay and set it to 500ms. Completed in 12 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate VS Code settings UI, change dropdown values, modify numeric input fields, use settings search bar
metadata.task_rationale: Tests same settings modification pattern but with different settings (tab size and format on save). Same complexity as original.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing editor.tabSize to 2 and enabling editor.formatOnSave. Evaluator reads settings.json and checks both values match expected.

Expected values are semantically correct for the instruction
No postconfig needed since settings.json is a persistent file on disk, not UI state
